QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] A Fate Most Unkind
QuestInfo.0: Eremos can tell you where the next phase of your training will be.
QuestInfo.1: Commander Von Leon is the lone custodian of the old castle in El Nath Mountains. Eremos insists this evil commander must be dealt justice. Defeat 500 monsters around the Lion King's Castle to thin his defenses.
QuestInfo.2: Eremos says it is imperative that Von Leon himself be defeated. He has instructed you to find and serve justice to him for his wrongdoing.
